name: Mesmerize
description:
You perform a technique within the domain of the Mesmer's Mask you're wearing. Roll the mask's Discovery Skill:

  • If the result exactly matches the Mask’s Discovery Number, you gain a randomly selected ability from that Mask's school (ignoring its XP cost), and immediately use it without paying its action or MP costs. Once the ability is resolved, roll the Mask's Discovery Skill to set its new Discovery Number.

  • Otherwise, the technique you perform is non-magical, but may still be effective. Your roll result becomes the Difficulty. State your intent and choose one or more creatures within short range; each rolls Awareness against the Difficulty and the GM adjudicates the outcome, as with a normal skill check.

You may use this ability any number of times in combat, and outside of combat once per day per Mask you have.

Describe your technique and how you learned it.
successes:
✨: You may adjust your result up or down by 1.

🌞: You gain and use the hidden ability as if you had matched the Discovery Number, regardless of the actual roll result.

💀: The technique has no effect and those around you see through it. Roll a new Discovery Number.
